question: Four sandstone replicas of the iconic Konark wheels from the Konark Temple have been installed at (the) _____.

options.text: Rashtrapati Bhavan’s Cultural Centre and Amrit Udyan

solution:
The correct answer is __**Rashtrapati Bhavan's Cultural Centre and Amrit Udyan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Four sandstone replicas of the iconic Konark wheels from the Konark Temple have been installed at **Rashtrapati Bhavan's Cultural Centre and Amrit Udyan**.
 
• The installation aims to showcase the rich cultural heritage of India and the architectural marvels of the Konark Temple.
 
• These replicas are crafted from sandstone to mirror the original Konark wheels' intricate designs and craftsmanship.
 
• The Konark Temple, also known as the Sun Temple, is a UNESCO World Heritage Site located in Odisha, India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Konark Temple**

 
 
• Built in the 13th century by King Narasimhadeva I of the Eastern Ganga dynasty.
 
• The temple is dedicated to the Hindu Sun God, Surya.
 
• Known for its architectural grandeur and intricate carvings, it is designed in the shape of a colossal chariot.
 
• The temple features 24 intricately carved wheels and is pulled by seven horses, symbolizing the seven days of the week.
 
 
 
• **Rashtrapati Bhavan**
 
 
• The official residence of the President of India, located in New Delhi.
 
• It was completed in 1929 and designed by British architect Sir Edwin Lutyens.
 
• The Cultural Centre at Rashtrapati Bhavan hosts various cultural events and exhibitions.
 
 
 
• **UNESCO World Heritage Sites**
 
 
• These sites are designated by UNESCO for their cultural, historical, scientific, or other forms of significance.
 
• The Konark Temple was declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1984.
 
• India is home to 40 UNESCO World Heritage Sites as of 2023.
